name: Taming the Dragon
source:
Taming the Dragon is an abstract depiction of the song by the same name by Brad Mehldau and Mark Guiliana. This is less a game and more a gallery of artwork. Explore the song at your own pace.

[From [url=https://rainmirage.itch.io/taming-the-dragon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Taming the Dragon》是对布拉德·梅尔道与马克·圭利亚纳同名乐曲的抽象演绎。它与其说是一款游戏，不如说是一座艺术作品展廊。按自己的节奏探索这首乐曲吧。

[来源：[url=https://rainmirage.itch.io/taming-the-dragon]Itch.io[/url]]
